Needs changes before merge. This is a SAFETY-tier review because the change modifies posted G-code.

The trial merge with upstream main `a49322b9c0c049bd0b3b2d1dea855de6087ac64b` is clean. I checked the current upstream rules. The required `Process change: yes` line is present. This PR does not change `PROCESS_VERSION` or golden files.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog.rs:50`: Select the schema from the post that the active setup uses. The options owner and the post owner can differ. With one setup that owns a Haas post and follows document options, `post_options_target()` returns `None`. The dialog then selects the document's Fanuc post. Apply stores changes under `builtin:Fanuc`, but posting reads `builtin:Haas`. The selected options have no effect on the output. Keep the options write target separate from the effective post. Add a test for this setup.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog.rs:266`: Pass the entered program prefix to the per-operation post. The dialog shows a `Program prefix` field, but this command carries only the directory. `State::post_program_folder` then uses `program_name()`, which reads the project filename. For `part.camproj`, entering `finish` still writes files with the `part` prefix. Pass the field through the command and test the resulting filenames.
3. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/post_dialog.rs:1` and the PR body: Add before/after screenshots for the new Post dialog and the changed Setup Post page. The body has no screenshots. Put the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body. Do not add images to this PR branch.

Local build and test results on the trial merge:

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: completed. I selected the changed post and app paths below from the plan. This was a plan check, not a full quick gate run.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-post --tests`: passed; 599 tests passed across 67 test targets.
- App suites `mcp_setup`, `per_op_files`, `post_script_options`, `posting`, `program_info`, `project_roundtrip`, `scripting`, `setup_mounts_post`, and `setup_post_options`: passed; 158 tests passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --lib`, from `crates/ui`: passed; 916 tests passed, 6 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

I repeated two mutations from the PR body in the review worktree:

- Replaced `fanuc.cps` with upstream main's file. `declared_options` failed: 1 passed, 2 failed. After restoration: 3 passed.
- Replaced `validate_overrides` with `Ok(())`. `declared_options` failed: 2 passed, 1 failed. After restoration: 3 passed.

Both mutations are restored. No PR golden files moved, so there are no changed golden lines to check. I did not run a GitHub workflow or launch the GUI. Native file pickers and all non-default controller option combinations were not exercised.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. The Post dialog now selects the active setup's effective post independently of the options write target. `dialog_uses_setups_own_post_while_options_follow_document` pins the Haas schema, document override storage, changed Haas output, and undo. Restoring the old selection makes the test fail. Restoring the fix makes it pass.
2. The per-operation command now carries the entered program prefix. `dialog_per_operation_post_uses_entered_prefix_in_filenames` enters `finish` and checks the actual `finish_01_Face1.nc` file. Removing the prefix makes the test fail with `part_01_Face1.nc`. Restoring the fix makes it pass.
3. The PR body now links four before/after images for the Post settings and Setup Post page. Only the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch contains these images. The before images use parent source `af83da0f4`. The old native picker is not captured; the captions state this limitation.

Head: `b5c91ad881b0a50b7006410c5c94f2dd735e7164`.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed: 3 steps, 0 failures. Post: 575 passed. App: 2690 passed. UI: 1029 passed.
`cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

The PR remains a draft. Please review this head again.

**Verdict: clean.** This is the second, independent safety-floor review of this PR. The author's own reviewer marker at the same head predates this comment. This review covers head b5c91ad881b0a50b7006410c5c94f2dd735e7164, trial-merged with main f90e9dc8e. The merge was clean. It needed no hand edits.

Gates this review ran on the merged tree:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-post`: green. All binaries passed (fail-fast, exit 0). The new `tests/declared_options.rs`: 3 passed.
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app`: green. All binaries passed (fail-fast, exit 0). The new `tests/post_script_options.rs`: 3 passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Safety-floor findings:
- The freshness gate (`op_streams_by`) and the warning-count gate in `posting.rs` are unchanged. A stale operation still refuses by name. A warning still blocks the write.
- The eight touched `.cps` files default to today's output. The golden suites pass with no moved golden. The Fanuc radius-arc path is geometrically correct against the absolute-centre `IJK` semantics of the intermediate stream. A full circle splits into two 180-degree R arcs. A G53 safe retract with no machine `safeRetractZ` raises a message, so the warning gate blocks the post rather than retracting fast.
- The reserved host keys (`Units`, `Threading`, `Smoothing`, `EndUnits`, `Explain`, `BetweenSetups`) are refused in a declaration and in an override. Malformed input gives a clean error by name: non-finite numbers, wrong types, unknown keys, duplicate keys, and inverted bounds. Validation runs at command creation, at project load, and at the CLI, MCP, and script edges.
- The Post dialog and `set_post_options` route every change through one undoable `SetPostSettings`. Undo restores each prior value. A script-option disagreement between setups is a visible problem in `program_problems` before the post.

Notes (not blockers):
1. A post that takes raw script text (`post_per_op_script*`, `--cps`, and the MCP `post` with a script) ignores stored per-post overrides. Only the script defaults and the per-run options apply there.
2. `SetPostSettings::new` drops a sub-command "already set" error with a string match on the message. A typed error would be more robust.
3. Stored options under a `file:` post key move silently when the `.cps` file is relocated. The old key keeps the values.
4. The `get_post_options` view maps a schema error to `unwrap_or_default()`. A read then shows empty `script_options` instead of a refusal.

Law checks: `Changelog:` line present. No new dependency in any `Cargo.toml`. No change under `.github/`, no `build.rs`, no script changes, no snapshot PNG change. `PROCESS_VERSION` untouched; the body states "Process change: yes". The decision record `docs/decisions/258-post-options-dialog.md` is present. New source files stay under about 400 lines. Added non-test code has no `unwrap()`, `expect()`, or `panic!()`. Refusal texts are plain English. The `.cps` additions hold no vendor text.

Label: `merge-ready` stands. This review confirms it.
